Payout of 15 July is short ₹8,332.97.
The bank credited ₹6,35,365.45 against an expected ₹6,43,698.42. 21 orders sit in this payout. No refund, chargeback or payment in the gateway ledger accounts for the difference, so the cause is not yet identified.
Suggested action: request the gateway's own breakdown for this payout, and check for a dispute debited but not yet reported.
